# Owner Creation & Duplicate Detection — Codebase Report

This is an OfficeFloor + Spring Boot PetClinic. The single write endpoint `POST /api/owners` is driven by a YAML-defined pipeline of small function classes. DTOs (`OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) are generated from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto` (no hand-written DTO source files exist).

Important: there is currently **no `identityKey` field or consolidated identity check**. `identityKey` appears only as a *future goal* in the test comment. Today duplicate detection is split into three independent guard steps (telephone, household, email), each with its own exception → 409.

---

## 1. Duplicate detection code

The POST pipeline runs three uniqueness guards, each iterating `ownerRepository.findAll()` and comparing normalized values.

### Telephone uniqueness
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureUniqueTelephone.java`
Compares the request's already-E.164-normalized telephone against every existing owner's telephone re-normalized via `TelephoneNormalizer.toE164(...)`. On match throws `DuplicateTelephoneException(telephone)`.

```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
        throws DuplicateTelephoneException {
    String telephone = request.getTelephone();
    for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
        if (telephone.equals(TelephoneNormalizer.toE164(existing.getTelephone()))) {
            throw new DuplicateTelephoneException(telephone);
        }
    }
}
```

### Email uniqueness
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureUniqueEmail.java`
Optional field; null/blank skips the check. Compares lower-cased (Locale.ROOT) email against existing owners' lower-cased emails. On match throws `DuplicateEmailException(email)`.

### Household uniqueness
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureUniqueHousehold.java`
Skipped when `request.getSharesHousehold() == true`. Builds a `HouseholdKey.of(lastName, address)` and compares against every existing owner's key. On match throws `DuplicateHouseholdException(lastName, address)`.

```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
        throws DuplicateHouseholdException {
    if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.getSharesHousehold())) {
        return;
    }
    String key = HouseholdKey.of(request.getLastName(), request.getAddress());
    for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
        if (key.equals(HouseholdKey.of(existing.getLastName(), existing.getAddress()))) {
            throw new DuplicateHouseholdException(request.getLastName(), request.getAddress());
        }
    }
}
```

### HouseholdKey (identity/hash logic)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdKey.java`
- `of(lastName, address)` → `normalize(lastName) + ' ' + normalize(address)`, where `normalize` trims, collapses whitespace to single space, and lower-cases (Locale.ROOT); null → `""`.
- `id(lastName, address)` → SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical `of(...)` key (this becomes the stored `householdId`).

### Email uniqueness

public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
        throws DuplicateHouseholdException {
    if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.getSharesHousehold())) {
        return;
    }
    String key = HouseholdKey.of(request.getLastName(), request.getAddress());

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Input only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>',
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address). Owners that opt in with
                sharesHousehold receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 3. Starts at 1, plus 1
                when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region) resolved from the owner's
                city using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: Derived preferred contact method; 'EMAIL' when the owner has
                an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      description: A page of pet owners.

      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.

          format: int32

        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

        totalPages:
          title: Total pages

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

    PetPage:

        totalElements:

        totalPages:
          title: Total pages

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>',
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address). Owners that opt in with
                sharesHousehold receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 3. Starts at 1, plus 1
                when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region) resolved from the owner's
                city using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: Derived preferred contact method; 'EMAIL' when the owner has
                an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I consolidated the three separate owner duplicate checks (telephone, email, household) into a single derived `identityKey`, and now reject a create with **409** only when a new owner's whole `identityKey` matches an existing owner's.

**New pieces**
- `OwnerIdentity` — derives the key `normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId`, computed identically for an incoming request and any existing owner (telephone canonicalized to E.164, email lower-cased), reusing the existing `TelephoneNormalizer`.
- `EnsureUniqueIdentity` — the single duplicate guard; recomputes existing owners' keys so it also covers seed data.
- `AssignIdentityKey` — stores the derived key on the entity so it is returned in the response.
- `DuplicateIdentityException` + handler + escalation YAML — one 409 path, replacing three, returning the conflicting `identityKey`.

**Changed**
- `owners.POST.yml` pipeline: email is now normalized *before* the single `ensureUniqueIdentity` step; the three old `ensureUnique*` steps are gone; `assignIdentityKey` runs after `assignHousehold`.
- `Owner` entity + all four DB schemas: new `identity_key` column.
- `openapi.yml`: added read-only `identityKey`; removed the now-defunct `sharesHousehold` input (its only purpose was bypassing the deleted household check).
